title: Token
description: Fiori token: a selectable, deletable value chip used by Tokenizer, MultiInput and MultiComboBox.

usage.summary: Represent one previously selected value as a selectable, removable item.
useWhen: Let users recognize and remove a value they have already selected.
Keep each token label concise and specific to the selected value.
Use readOnly when the selected value must remain visible without a delete action.

avoidWhen.when: Navigate, select or delete a group of selected values with overflow handling.
Show a category or status label that is not a removable selection.
